column3: Close to the Hebrew; “knowing thus, it will last long” is rendered “and knowledge Right will be prolonged,” supplying “Right.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a sweeping rain” is rendered “a driving rain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “perverse of two ways” is rendered “perverse in his ways.”
Close to the Hebrew; “interest and increase” is rendered “usury and extortion.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man is searched for” is rendered “men hide themselves.”
Close to the Hebrew; מְפַחֵד (“fears”) is rendered “is… reverent.”
Close to the Hebrew; “great of extortions” is rendered “is a great oppressor,” and “unjust gain” “covetousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “oppressed by the blood of a life” is rendered “burdened with bloodshed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will fall at once” is rendered “will suddenly fall.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of destruction” is rendered “a destroyer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “arrogant of soul” is rendered “of a proud heart,” and “will be made fat” “will be prospered.”
